title: About this site
description: A modern blog system based on Github
content:
📦 The website is fully stored on a GitHub repository, with all versions controllable

🚀 No backend or serverless functions, pure static site

✏️ Articles can be edited directly via a visual UI and submitted to the GitHub repository

🔑 All users can edit, with submissions requiring the Owner’s Private Key

## Thanks

This site is built on top of these open-source projects and works, thanks to their creators.

### Templates and Frameworks

- [2025-blog-public](https://github.com/YYsuni/2025-blog-public) — This site is a modified version of this blog template · YYsuni · [MIT](https://github.com/YYsuni/2025-blog-public/blob/main/LICENSE)
- [Next.js](https://nextjs.org)、[React](https://react.dev)、[Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com)、[Motion](https://motion.dev) — MIT；[TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org) — Apache-2.0

### Font

- [Huiwen Mingcho (Revised)](https://github.com/bosswnx/huiwenmincho-improved) — Chinese font for the entire site, modified based on Huiwen Mingcho · [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.zh-hans)
- [Averia Gruesa Libre](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Averia+Gruesa+Libre) — English font for titles · Dan Sayers · [SIL OFL 1.1](https://openfontlicense.org)

### Icons and Rendering

- [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) — Interface icons · [ISC](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/main/LICENSE)
- [Shiki](https://shiki.style) for code highlighting, [KaTeX](https://katex.org) for formula rendering, [marked](https://marked.js.org) for Markdown parsing — MIT

### Live2D Signboard Lady

- [Siamese Cat Xiaodunmi Live2D model](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV16t4y1M7Dd/) — Signboard lady model, shared freely on Bilibili by [Genius Designer](https://space.bilibili.com/72073139); the copyright of the character "Xiaodunmi" belongs to nobeko
- [Live2D Cubism Core](https://www.live2d.com/sdk/) — Live2D Inc. · [Live2D Proprietary Software License](https://www.live2d.com/eula/live2d-proprietary-software-license-agreement_en.html)
- [PixiJS](https://pixijs.com)、[pixi-live2d-display](https://github.com/guansss/pixi-live2d-display) — MIT

### Music page lyrics animation effects

- [Folia](https://github.com/chthollyphile/folia-major) — The word-by-word lyrics animation effects for the "Immersive Lyrics" section on the music page (Luminous, Mindscape, Cloud Steps, Fume, Claddagh, Tilt, Stillness) and the lyrics analysis pipeline are transplanted from this project · chthollyphile · [AGPL-3.0](https://github.com/chthollyphile/folia-major/blob/main/LICENSE)
- [pretext](https://github.com/chenglou/pretext) — Lyrics text measurement and layout · chenglou · MIT

### Tools

- [cn-font-split](https://github.com/KonghaYao/cn-font-split) — Splits Chinese fonts by unicode-range · KonghaYao · [Apache-2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)

If you notice your work being used on this site with incorrect attribution or if you would like it to be removed, please let me know via the contact information on the homepage, and I will handle it promptly.
